_comment: How this venue was built, so it can be built again. Written by scripts/build-venue.mjs on every build; replayed with "npm run venues:rebuild -- big-kahunas". "box" is the bounding box before "pad" was applied to it, which is why a venue asked for by place name, by box or by a point and a radius all record the same field. Edit it by hand if you like — a rebuild reads whatever is here. Written from the manifest rather than by the build that made it: this park arrived before recipes existed, and the bounds a manifest keeps are the padded ones, so the box here is the padded box and the pad is 0. The centre is the one the build was given, which for this park matters — its own polygon runs north over its car park. The next build overwrites this with what it actually did.
name: Big Kahuna's
